title: Commit: fix(kernel): complete base-unit migration and hermetic e2e recovery
content:
fix(kernel): complete base-unit migration and hermetic e2e recovery

- Mempool/state/economics fully u128 base-unit based (ATC_BASE_UNITS = 1e18)
- Wallet RPC transports u128 amounts as decimal string (JSON precision)
- atc-node e2e tests: hermetic per-test data dirs and ephemeral P2P ports
- Validator snapshot recovery sealed via (ValidatorWeights, ValidatorKeys)
- Clippy: -D warnings clean across workspace; type aliases for snapshots
- Workspace: 35 test suites green, cargo fmt clean
